verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a commerce and payments platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes a Stripe-hosted service: Stripe handles routing, SPT creation and settlement to the Stripe balance, and the MCP server is hosted. The open-sourced pieces are the ACP spec (Apache 2.0), the MPP spec and SDK, and the Link CLI client, not a self-hostable deployment of the Agentic Commerce Suite itself, so there is no evidence the core product can be self-hosted.
